(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: The shopper is obliged to obtain a cart at some point during the trip.
The shopper is prohibited from exiting the store without a cart.
The shopper is obliged to leave from the exit while holding a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from being at cell (3,1) while holding a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from moving north from cell (3,3) while holding a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from interacting at cell (3,1) while holding a cart.
Whenever the shopper is without a cart, they are obliged to later have a cart again.
After interacting at cell (3,1), the shopper is obliged to return to cell (3,3) and interact there.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are forbidden in single-file shelf aisles, i.e. narrow passages flanked by shelves on both sides.
A shopper must not move from an open area into a single-file shelf aisle while still holding a cart.
When a shopper with a cart interacts at the mouth of a single-file shelf aisle, the interaction must be a cart-parking action.
After parking a cart to enter a narrow shelf aisle, the shopper is obliged to retrieve a cart before leaving the store.
After interacting with an item inside a single-file shelf aisle, the shopper must return cartless to a wide aisle mouth.
A shopper may set down a cart only in a wide open aisle zone, not beside shelf faces or inside narrow shelf aisles.
A shopper without a cart must not move along a wide shelf-facing aisle, although cartless movement inside narrow shelf aisles is allowed.
Items reachable from open shelf-facing aisles should be collected while keeping the cart, unlike items inside single-file shelf aisles.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are forbidden in single-file shelf aisles, i.e. narrow passages flanked by shelves on both sides.
A shopper must not move from an open area into a single-file shelf aisle while still holding a cart.
When a shopper with a cart interacts at the mouth of a single-file shelf aisle, the interaction must be a cart-parking action.
After parking a cart to enter a narrow shelf aisle, the shopper is obliged to retrieve a cart before leaving the store.
After interacting with an item inside a single-file shelf aisle, the shopper must return cartless to a wide aisle mouth.
A shopper may set down a cart only in a wide open aisle zone, not beside shelf faces or inside narrow shelf aisles.
A shopper without a cart must not move along a wide shelf-facing aisle, although cartless movement inside narrow shelf aisles is allowed.
Items reachable from open shelf-facing aisles should be collected while keeping the cart, unlike items inside single-file shelf aisles.
